note: Metabolic state slider. s = 0 fed (postprandial, portal glucose/insulin high), s = 1 fasted (glucagon high). Flux weights per pathway variant are linear between the fed and fasted values given in pathways.json.

stops.label: Fed
stops.text: Postprandial: high portal glucose and insulin. Glucokinase, glycogen synthase and de novo lipogenesis are active; malonyl-CoA inhibits CPT1 so beta-oxidation is low; VLDL secretion and bile-acid uptake (post-meal enterohepatic return) are high.

stops.label: Post-absorptive
stops.text: Hormones cross over. Glycogen is broken down to hold plasma glucose; gluconeogenesis begins; fatty-acid oxidation rises as adipose lipolysis delivers free fatty acids.

stops.label: Fasted
stops.text: Prolonged fast: glucagon high, insulin low. Gluconeogenesis dominates glucose output, mitochondrial beta-oxidation is maximal and ketogenesis is on; glycogen stores are depleted (rosettes shrink).
